navigation_model: Pushed columns: home, category, manager and detail are stacked routes; depth is kinetic, the arriving column travels and the one behind recedes.

deep_link_grammar.demo_suffix: ?demo=<demoStateId> — a demo state is part of the link so a reviewer can hand over an exact screen
deep_link_grammar.arity_rule: Exact arities only. A route with a stray segment is malformed, not a lenient prefix match.
deep_link_grammar.unknown_target_rule: A well-formed route that names nothing renders the home surface plus an inline notice quoting the link. No dead control, no blank screen.
deep_link_grammar.history: hashchange drives back and forward; a restored route is written with replace so it is not a phantom back step.
deep_link_grammar.encoding_rule: Every segment is encodeURIComponent-encoded; a broken escape such as %zz makes the whole hash malformed rather than a literal id.
deep_link_grammar.verified: 34/34 parser cases pass (26 parse cases plus 8 format/parse round-trips)

state_wiring.store: shared/pm-store.js — semantic state only, never DOM measurements, so the model ports to a Slint property graph
state_wiring.restore_rule: The hash wins on load. With no hash, the saved route is restored with replace. Review-strip state (theme, width, rail, panel, reduced motion) is restored at mount, so a reviewer who reloads keeps the exact screen.
state_wiring.shell_state_channel: PMShell.mount({ onShellState }) — the shell owns the controls, the concept owns persistence. Every theme/width/rail/panel/motion change reports through this one callback; without it the keys would be written once at startup and never updated.
state_wiring.untrusted_input_rule: A persisted theme is not trusted: setTheme() rejects an id that is not one of the eight built-ins and falls back to the concept's declared identity theme, because an unknown data-theme matches no rules and leaves the page with no theme at all.

receipt_wiring.simulation: shared/pm-sim.js — seeded, not random; every operation returns a dated receipt naming the production call it would make
receipt_wiring.bridge: Every receipt raised anywhere on the page is pushed to the title-bar notification inbox by the shell, so an operation can never appear twice or not at all
receipt_wiring.sound_rule: PACKET/06: sound is never the only indication — the inbox entry is structural

notification_surface.canonical: Title-bar stack/inbox only: button.pm-notify[aria-haspopup=dialog] with span.pm-notify-count and div.pm-notify-panel[role=dialog]
notification_surface.verified: No .toast class or toast function exists in any file in this folder

manager_insertion_contract.rule: A manager that is not registered still resolves: the kit returns an honest cross-concept pointer rather than an empty screen

shell_contract.mount: window.PMShell.mount({rootId, concept, conceptId, theme, demoState, onDemoState, onReceiptAction, onLayout, onWidthMode})
owns: review strip (theme, width, reduced motion, demo state, reset)
shell_contract.width_modes: squeezed <820, narrow <1100, normal. Evaluated at explicit checkpoints: mount, an observed resize, and every setWidth() call. It never depends on ResizeObserver delivery alone, because RO is tied to the rendering lifecycle and a backgrounded tab can otherwise sit at 900px still classified normal.
